stem:
A plastic tube is arranged on a lab tabletop as shown. A small sphere enters one end of the tube with enough speed to come out the other end of the tube.

Which diagram shows where the sphere will go first when it leaves the tube?

options.label: A
options.text: (Image of tube with a dot near the inside curve near the tube end)

options.label: B
options.text: (Image of tube with a dot near the inside curve near the start of the tube)

options.label: C
options.text: (Image of tube with a dot near the outside curve near the start of the tube)

options.label: D
options.text: (Image of tube with a dot near the outside curve near the middle of the tube)

visual_elements: Overhead View of Tabletop with plastic tube spiral and sphere entering
Diagram A with sphere near inside curve near tube end
Diagram B with sphere near inside curve near start
Diagram C with sphere near outside curve near start
Diagram D with sphere near outside curve near middle
notes: Images described for answer choices; original images contain circle representations with dots indicating sphere position after exit.
